title: As a delivery lead, I want to define reporting cadence and thresholds so that time reporting is consistent
description:
Story:
As a delivery lead, I want to define the reporting cadence, time window, and thresholds, so that time reporting is consistent and actionable.

Acceptance:
- Cadence, time window, and timezone are agreed and documented
- Thresholds are defined (global or per role/profile)
- Recipients (project leads and stakeholders) are confirmed

title: As an admin, I want to manage user profiles with hourly rates so that cost calculations are accurate
description:
Story:
As an admin, I want to manage user profiles with hourly rates, so that cost calculations are accurate and maintainable.

Acceptance:
- Profile entity includes name, discipline, level, costPerHour, active
- Users can be linked to a profile
- Migration and seed data create baseline profiles

title: As an admin, I want to set project budgets with currency so that cost tracking is meaningful
description:
Story:
As an admin, I want to set project budgets with currency, so that cost tracking is meaningful and consistent.

Acceptance:
- Project includes budgetAmount and currency
- Defaults are applied for existing projects
- Validation prevents negative or invalid values

title: As an admin, I want APIs to manage profiles, assignments, and budgets so that the UI can manage them
description:
Story:
As an admin, I want APIs to manage profiles, user assignments, and project budgets, so that the UI can manage them securely.

Acceptance:
- CRUD endpoints exist for profiles
- Endpoints exist to assign profiles to users
- Endpoints exist to update project budgets
- DTO validation uses class-validator

title: As a finance stakeholder, I want time entry costs computed so that reports include cost data
description:
Story:
As a finance stakeholder, I want time entry costs computed, so that reports include reliable cost data.

Acceptance:
- Cost is calculated as hours * profile costPerHour
- Decision documented: snapshot stored or computed on query
- Existing entries are backfilled if needed

title: As an admin, I want UI screens to manage profiles, assignments, and budgets so that I can maintain data
description:
Story:
As an admin, I want UI screens to manage profiles, user assignments, and project budgets, so that I can maintain data without DB access.

Acceptance:
- Admin UI can list/create/edit profiles
- Admin UI can assign profiles to users
- Admin UI can edit project budgets
- Forms have validation and error handling

title: As an admin, I want to manage report recipients so that company reports reach the right people
description:
Story:
As an admin, I want to manage report recipients, so that company reports reach the right people.

Acceptance:
- StakeholderRecipient model exists (email, active, name/label)
- CRUD endpoints are admin-only
- Admin UI can manage recipients

title: As a project lead, I want aggregated team hours per time window so that I can monitor overages
description:
Story:
As a project lead, I want aggregated team hours per time window, so that I can monitor overages and workload.

Acceptance:
- Service aggregates hours by project lead for a time window
- Over-threshold members are flagged
- Cost summaries are included when available

title: As a stakeholder, I want a company-wide report so that I can see total hours and budget variance
description:
Story:
As a stakeholder, I want a company-wide report, so that I can see total hours, costs, and budget variance.

Acceptance:
- Service aggregates total hours and costs
- Budget variance is calculated (over/under)
- Summary totals and breakdowns are included

title: As a recipient, I want clear report emails so that I can act on over-hours cases
description:
Story:
As a recipient, I want clear report emails, so that I can act on over-hours cases.

Acceptance:
- HTML and text templates exist for project lead and company reports
- Templates render correctly with real data
- Over-hours warnings are included

title: As an operator, I want report jobs processed by queues so that delivery is reliable
description:
Story:
As an operator, I want report jobs processed by queues, so that delivery is reliable and retry-safe.

Acceptance:
- BullMQ queues defined for project lead and company reports
- Worker processors implemented in worker_app
- Jobs are idempotent and retry-safe

title: As an admin, I want to schedule or manually trigger report jobs so that timing is flexible
description:
Story:
As an admin, I want to schedule or manually trigger report jobs, so that timing is flexible and controllable.

Acceptance:
- Repeatable jobs (cron) configured for each report type
- Admin endpoint triggers jobs manually
- Schedules are configurable without code changes

title: As an admin, I want report run logs so that I can audit delivery and failures
description:
Story:
As an admin, I want report run logs, so that I can audit delivery and failures.

Acceptance:
- Report run metadata is stored (time, status, recipients, errors)
- Admin endpoint lists recent runs
- Failures include debug details

title: As a security owner, I want strict access control so that reporting data is least-privilege
description:
Story:
As a security owner, I want strict access control, so that reporting data follows least-privilege.

Acceptance:
- Admin-only access to profiles, budgets, recipients
- Project leads only receive data for their projects
- Key endpoints and UI flows are permission-checked

title: As a QA engineer, I want tests for cost and reporting logic so that regressions are caught
description:
Story:
As a QA engineer, I want tests for cost and reporting logic, so that regressions are caught early.

Acceptance:
- Unit tests cover cost and threshold logic
- Integration tests cover report aggregation
- Worker job tests cover BullMQ processors

title: As an operator, I want reporting documentation so that setup and operations are clear
description:
Story:
As an operator, I want reporting documentation, so that setup and operations are clear.

Acceptance:
- Required env vars are documented
- Runbook covers triggering reports and reading logs
- Cost and budget variance rules are described

title: As an admin, I want cumulative Teamwork hours before forecast weeks so that I see past effort
description:
Story:
As an admin, I want a cumulative Teamwork hours column before forecast weeks, so that I see past effort at a glance.

Acceptance:
- Column appears before the first forecastable week
- Cutoff is project start through the end of the previous week
- Column is visible only to admin/list roles

title: As a project manager, I want planned absences imported from Factorial so that forecasts are realistic
description:
Story:
As a project manager, I want planned absences imported from Factorial, so that forecasts are realistic.

Acceptance:
- New job imports forecasted absences with date ranges
- Absences are stored per user
- Job runs independently of Teamwork imports

title: As a project manager, I want an absences summary panel so that I can see upcoming time off
description:
Story:
As a project manager, I want an absences summary panel, so that I can see upcoming time off without cluttering the table.

Acceptance:
- Collapsible section above the forecast table
- Per-user list of upcoming absence dates
- Data matches Factorial import

title: As a data engineer, I want Teamwork entries without tasks imported so that no time is lost
description:
Story:
As a data engineer, I want Teamwork entries without tasks imported, so that no time is lost.

Acceptance:
- Missing-task entries are mapped to a default task (e.g. "project general")
- Import logs include counts of recovered entries
- No entries are dropped due to missing tasks

title: As a data engineer, I want a reconciliation mode so that I can debug missing Teamwork entries
description:
Story:
As a data engineer, I want a reconciliation mode for a short time window, so that I can debug missing Teamwork entries by user.

Acceptance:
- Fetches a recent window (7-15 days)
- Compares imported entries per user vs Teamwork source
- Produces a discrepancy report

title: As a portfolio owner, I want projects flagged as chargeable so that reporting separates chargeable work
description:
Story:
As a portfolio owner, I want projects flagged as chargeable, so that reporting separates chargeable and non-chargeable work.

Acceptance:
- Project has a chargeable boolean
- Admin UI can edit the flag
- Report summarizes chargeable vs non-chargeable totals

title: As an admin, I want per-user standard hours so that capacity reflects contract exceptions
description:
Story:
As an admin, I want per-user standard hours, so that capacity reflects contract exceptions (e.g. 36h or 75%).

Acceptance:
- StandardHours table stores weekly hours per user
- Admin UI can edit standard hours
- No migration required for updates
